static_traits.name: 罗维
static_traits.social_status: 有朋友可交流，但not yet分享Self-doubt与without价值感的深度程度；Interpersonal relationships受到影响，常向朋友寻求对作品的认可
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 略显紧张但表达清晰、配合度较好；逻辑清楚，能识do not并描述自动化思维；Self-denial倾向明显

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己作为Photographer永远not够好，without法被发表，这让我感到without价值和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到Self-doubt正在阻碍我在摄影事业上的进步并影响我的心理健康，因此决定寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 在开始以摄影为职业后，先是带着兴奋进行投稿，但向多家杂志投稿遭遇拒绝；此后压力加剧，逐渐发展为完全回避投稿以避免再次被拒；每当想到投稿或与已发表Photographer进行比较时，便出现强烈的Self-doubt与without价值感；曾尝试从朋友和家人处寻求认可，但并not yet缓解Self-doubt。

special_situations.event: The moment of thinking about submitting work to magazines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再次Being rejected，就证明我永远not够好、have not价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 完全回避投稿以避免Being rejected与羞耻感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一定会Being rejected，结果只会很糟糕

special_situations.event: 回想之前被杂志拒稿的经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次或几次拒稿意味着I will never succeed、作品客观not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces the frequency of creating and submitting; procrastinates on projects to reduce frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这说明我not行，以后也not会有改变

special_situations.event: 与已发表的Photographer及其作品进行比较
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only reaching their level and being published counts as valuable; otherwise a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequent self-criticism and abandoning or delaying projects
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not可能达到他们的水平，我not如他们

special_situations.event: When friends and family give positive feedback and encouragement
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 除非被杂志发表，否则他人的肯定都not可信、not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 继续寻求外部验证但negate其中的积极信息
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是安慰我，这些好评not算数

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, to have works published, and to be truly seen
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected与被negate，担心暴露自身“without价值/not够好”的真相
defense_goal: 通过回避投稿来保持安全感、减少Being rejected的可能
通过寻求他人认可来暂时缓解Anxiety与Self-doubt

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、随时会Being rejected的创作者
object_relations.object_representation: 他人（尤其杂志编辑/已发表Photographer）是严苛的评判者与拒绝者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about submitting to a magazine, or when invited in counseling to make a concrete submission plan
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将可能的反馈视为必然的拒绝，体验他人（编辑/咨询师）为挑剔的评判者（移情：他人会negate我）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以谨慎与Withdrawal的语气强调“现在not是时候”，提出诸多实际困难，避免做出明确承诺。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to accept friends' positive feedback or discuss self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人的肯定not真实，只是在敷衍自己（移情：他人表面支持、内心negate）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 通过质疑他人的动机与真实性，语气防御，强调“他们not会理解”，并尝试转开话题。

manifestations: 将“被发表”视为自我价值的唯一标准，not yet被发表即体验为without价值
Self-doubt与失败感Reinforcement了对创作意义的困惑
Living alone但与朋友not yet分享内心痛苦的深度程度
Worries about being misunderstood or evaluated, reduces real contact
outcomes: Seeking external validation but struggling to internalize self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在会谈中多次Self-denial与谨慎表达
对投稿采取过度小心与Withdrawal的策略
担心被误解而not愿分享更深层的感受

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 预设朋友not会理解自己，担心被评价为“矫情”
在not yet证实的情况下判断他人会negate或敷衍自己

positive_force: Willing to try cognitive restructuring and small steps
能Identify automatic thoughts，愿意在会谈外练习
Has a certain level of social support (has friends to communicate with)
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的认知模式显著
Black-and-white thinking and excessive comparison with others
Avoids submissions and project procrastination, depends on external validation
自我价值与“被发表”过度绑定，negate正向反馈

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding submitting to magazines and delaying creative projects
antecedent: 看到或比较已发表Photographer的作品
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕Being rejected与被negate，核心认知为“I am not good enough/have not价值”
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在负面评价与羞耻感，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Career development受阻，机会减少，动机与生产力下降

target_behavior.behavior: 频繁向朋友与家人寻求认可
antecedent: 在比较他人或想到投稿之后
target_behavior.core_reason: 通过外部验证来缓解not安与Self-doubt，难以内化自我价值
target_behavior.function: 获得安慰与短期情绪缓冲
target_behavior.consequence: 对外部评价依赖增加，自主评价能力下降，Self-doubt仍持续
